mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO content_review (review_id, target_type, target_id, author_id, review_round, action, source, operator_id, reason, reason_code, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{authorId}, #{reviewRound}, #{action}, #{source}, #{operatorId}, #{reason}, #{reasonCode}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT reason FROM content_review WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND action = 'REJECT' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT target_id AS targetId, MAX(create_time) AS createTime FROM content_review WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND action = 'APPROVE' GROUP BY target_id
